# PS3-R pilot: paired-contrast result and the AE vs contrastive vs raw recommendation

Satoshi, successor technical lead · 2026-10-01 · label **PILOT_ENGINEERING**.

Scope: ETH 4h, 20 stratified inputs (397b67d6, seed 20261001), one feature per branch, 3 inner folds, 2 seeds, inner-fold validation only. Neither the outer validation (2024) nor the protected test (2025) was read. **No forecasting score is claimed.** All values are probe losses on business targets (MSE of log returns) against the paired naive (zero return) on identical rows.

## Generated by the tested tool

`tools/ps3r_pilot_contrast.py` (8 tests: it refuses overlapping rows, unpaired rows, self-forecast targets, pooled latents and an unpaired random arm) ran on worker_b under crispdm-run 512M: 2.91 s wall, 27 MB peak.

- **Records:** 240/240, with 0 failed fits. 125 were reused by data sha256 plus objective sha after PS3R-STOP-02.
- **Paired table:** `CONTRAST.json`, sha256 `1f54d14c6465497d5824aa7200ebbacb407c3c584d66b9346e377f550ba8cf74`. It has 840 paired rows (20 inputs × 3 folds × 2 seeds × 7 target-horizons) and 140 summary rows.
- **Cards:** 40 cards (20 inputs × AE/contrastive), all validated by feature-extractor `app.representation_card` at a0a2e21. All 40 are `ADMISSIBLE` with temporal contract `SATISFIED`; each carries the TS2Vec deviations, the objective identity and the raw-input identity.
- **CPU cost:**

| Component | Seconds |
|---|---|
| Total wall across all 240 records (each record in its own process) | 11 775.9 |
| Fit, contrastive | 8 532.2 |
| Fit, AE | 1 445.5 |
| Contrastive tracing, estimated, included in the contrastive fit time | 3 681.8 |
| Measured rate per record | AE 25.1 s, contrastive 87.3 s |

- **Stop reasons:** contrastive: patience 70, max_epochs 41, no_improvement_over_initial 9. AE: patience 75, max_epochs 45.

## What the table says (`ANALYSIS.txt`)

**1. Every arm loses to the paired naive on average, at every horizon.** Mean (loss − naive) is positive everywhere:

| Target | raw | random | AE | contrastive |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Y_s@4h | +3.3e-07 | +4.8e-06 | +5.1e-06 | +3.9e-06 |
| Y_l@24h | +5.4e-06 | +8.5e-05 | +1.1e-04 | +7.1e-05 |
| Y_l@144h | +1.3e-04 | +3.5e-01 | +9.3e-04 | +5.8e-04 |

The random arm's mean at 144 h comes from a probe blow-up on random latents.

**2. Strict minimum per cell (840 cells; lowest loss wins, no tolerance):** raw 570, contrastive 117, random 80, AE 73.

**3. Cells beating the naive:** raw 232, AE 156, random 150, contrastive 147.

**4. Training adds information less than half the time.** Δ_probe > 0 (trained beats its own untrained initial state on identical rows) in AE 383/840 and contrastive 366/840 cells.

**5. AE vs contrastive.** The mean contrast loss_AE − loss_contrastive is positive at every horizon, so contrastive is lower on average. Per cell the split is close to even: AE is better in 53–66 of 120 cells per horizon. Contrastive costs about 5.9× the AE's fit seconds.

## Recommendation for the modular front (strict-minimum rule)

**Raw wins.** Under the strict-minimum rule the raw-window arm is best in 570 of 840 cells. Neither the AE control nor the contrastive objective earns adoption as a default branch-pretraining objective (R1/R2 donor source) for single-feature ETH 4h branches.

- **Keep end-to-end R0 and the raw controls** as the reference.
- **Keep both objectives available as declared options.** If one objective is carried into further experiments, contrastive is the better of the two: lower mean probe loss at every horizon. It is not a winner, given the even per-cell split and its 5.9× cost.
- **Do not start strategy work from any of these representations.** All arms are worse than the naive on average, which fails the owner's eligibility rule.

**Limits:**
- 20 inputs, 2 seeds, inner-fold validation only.
- One feature per branch.
- The probe is a linear ridge on the flattened latent (384 dimensions against raw's 24), and the penalty often sits at the grid edge (1000). Part of raw's advantage may be the probe's dimensionality, not the information in the input.
- Results are NOT_COMPARABLE to TS2Vec Table 7.
- This is not a forecasting result.
